Hmm — no n gives exactly 32768? Let me check: len(raw_at(n)) = len(head) + n where head has a fixed prefix except CL digits. Let me compute the actual value.

head prefix length = "MESSAGE sip:x@y.z SIP/2.0
" (24+2=26) + "From: sip:a@b.c
" (17) + "To: <sip:x@y.z>
" (17) + "Call-ID: c
" (12) + "CSeq: 1 MESSAGE
" (17) + "Content-Length: " (16) + str(n) + "

" (4).

26+17+17+12+17+16+4 = 109. So total = 109 + len(str(n)) + n. For n=32657: 109+5+32657 = 32771. Hmm too big. For total 32768: n + len(str(n)) = 32659 → n = 32654 (5 digits) → 32654+5 = 32659 ✓. So n=32654 gives 32768. My range started at 32700 which is too high. Let me widen the range: range(32000, 32769).
